name: When should I consider a second-story addition instead of moving to a larger home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a second-story addition instead of moving to a larger home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a second-story addition when you need more space but love your current neighborhood, school district, or have strong ties to your community. It's also a viable option if your lot size prevents horizontal expansion, or if property values in your area make moving significantly more expensive than remodeling. Adding a second story can also increase your property value without the costs and disruptions associated with selling, buying, and relocating. This choice often provides tailored space improvements that a new home might not offer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a second-story addition if you need more space but want to stay in your current location, if lot size is a constraint, or if it's more cost-effective than moving. It increases property value and allows for customized expansion.
